brief: 6 viral content formats every creator should steal.

slots.title: Steal these formats
slots.ctaText: Six viral hooks that actually work

slots.title: Storytelling threads
slots.body: People crave narratives, not lectures. Start with a relatable struggle and build tension in every slide. Watch saves explode.

slots.title: Listicle carousels
slots.body: Break down one big idea into bite-sized slides. Numbered lists make your content super skimmable and shareable. Easy wins.

slots.title: Meme remixes
slots.body: Hop on trending audio or formats but add your niche twist. Relatable humor builds trust faster than any sales pitch ever will.

slots.title: Before and after
slots.body: Show a transformation that stops the scroll. Whether it’s a mindset shift or a workspace glow-up, contrast is pure engagement gold.

slots.title: Hot takes
slots.body: Say what everyone’s thinking but nobody’s saying. A spicy opinion sparks comments, debates, and algorithmic love in minutes.

slots.title: POV videos
slots.body: Put viewers inside the moment with a strong point-of-view angle. It feels personal, immersive, and weirdly addictive to watch.
